items.title: Character.AI Files for Bankruptcy as Disney Bids $20 Million—And Users Get Grief Resources
items.summary: The chatbot app once valued at $1 billion is up for sale in a Delaware court, two weeks after launching new models. If nobody buys it, it shuts down.

items.title: Binance Is Shutting Down Its Bitcoin Mining Pool After Six Years
items.summary: Binance will discontinue Binance Pool, Pool Savings, Cloud Mining, and other related services in a retreat from mining infrastructure.

items.title: Most tokenized stock trading on Solana, BNB Chain occurs outside US market hours
items.summary: Tokenized equities have reached nearly $3.3 billion in value as investors embrace round-the-clock access beyond Wall Street hours.

items.title: Bitcoin Whale That Sat Through Every Crash Since 2020 Just Moved $377M
items.summary: A wallet that received 4,581 BTC in March 2020, worth about $40 million then, moved its stash today when it was worth about $377 million.

items.title: Trezor reduces resellers as a ‘preventative step’ amid Ledger tampering reports
items.summary: CCO Danny Sanders said he had notified certain hardware wallet resellers that they would be removed from Trezor’s list of authorized entities starting Jan. 1.

items.title: Strive Buys $280 Million in Bitcoin, Its Largest Purchase in Months
items.summary: The Nasdaq-listed asset manager bought the Bitcoin at an average of about $84,500 during a rough week for the market, lifting its total stash to 32,773 BTC.

items.title: AI Researchers Are Smoking Cigarettes to Prove AI Will Cure Cancer, Says Palantir Exec
items.summary: Palantir CTO Shyam Sankar says many AI researchers have taken up smoking to signal their faith in AI.

items.title: The Amount of Bitcoin on Exchanges Is Shrinking. Is a Rally Imminent?
items.summary:
Bitcoin Magazine  
  
 The Amount of Bitcoin on Exchanges Is Shrinking. Is a Rally Imminent?  
 A CryptoQuant researcher has said that bitcoin’s supply dynamics could soon help its price.   
 This post  The Amount of Bitcoin on Exchanges Is Shrinking. Is a Rally Imminent?  first appeared on  Bitcoin Magazine  and is written by  Mathew Di Salvo .

items.title: How the SEC’s lack of leadership could facilitate crypto rulemaking
items.summary: A recent change in the SEC’s rules on quorum could make it easier for the agency to amend its approach to crypto regulation in the absence of a market structure bill.

items.title: Bitcoin Shakes Off Spooky Season Jitters: Can Bulls Keep It Going?
items.summary: Bitcoin dipped below $81,000 before buyers stepped in, but the Fear and Greed Index says traders aren't convinced yet.

items.title: Trezor Cuts Its Resellers After Ledger Finds Spy Implant in Crypto Wallets
items.summary: Trezor is ending reseller authorizations on January 1, 2027, after Ledger confirmed that wallets sold by a Southeast Asian retailer carried a hidden implant that sent out users' recovery phrases.

items.title: Trezor Reduces Number of Resellers Following Ledger Drainage Incident
items.summary:
Bitcoin Magazine  
  
 Trezor Reduces Number of Resellers Following Ledger Drainage Incident   
 Hardware manufacturer Trezor has said it is checking which vendors it works with following reports of lost funds from Ledger models.  
 This post  Trezor Reduces Number of Resellers Following Ledger Drainage Incident   first appeared on  Bitcoin Magazine  and is written by  Mathew Di Salvo .

items.title: Ripple, Stripe-owned Privy partner to bring embedded wallets to XRP Ledger
items.summary: Developers can now build XRPL wallets into apps via Privy, with support for XRP, RLUSD, AI agent payments and x402.

items.title: Strive reports $208M in warrant exercises as Bitcoin holdings jump 11%
items.summary: Strive is now the fifth-largest publicly traded corporate Bitcoin holder, with 32,773 BTC, as it continues to expand its treasury through equity financing.

items.title: Crypto exchange MNX takes on OKX, BitGet offering pre-IPO futures for AI giants
items.summary: MNX is offering a different way to trade the future valuations of private AI companies, including OpenAI, Anthropic and DeepSeek.

items.title: Strive Buys More Bitcoin, Crosses 30,000 BTC Mark

Bitcoin Magazine  
  
 Strive Buys More Bitcoin, Crosses 30,000 BTC Mark   
 The bitcoin treasury company is still the fifth biggest in the space.  
 This post  Strive Buys More Bitcoin, Crosses 30,000 BTC Mark   first appeared on  Bitcoin Magazine  and is written by  Mathew Di Salvo .

items.title: Bitcoin keeps up pressure on $84K as US stocks skirt Korea tech sell-off
items.summary: Bitcoin price action preserved overnight gains as US stocks quickly rebounded after opening lower on the back of Korea’s tech-stock rout.

items.title: UK crypto trader says almost $800,000 lost in knife attack as wrench attacks proliferate
items.summary: A crypto trader in the U.K. claimed masked intruders stole nearly $800,000 in cryptocurrency at knifepoint, furthering concerns of "wrench attacks" spreading in the country.

items.title: Interactive Brokers expands crypto services with Ethereum staking via Zerohash
items.summary: Interactive Brokers now lets eligible clients stake ETH through its Client Portal, with zerohash providing the service.

items.title: DRW and Marex complete OTC swap referencing tokenized S&P iBoxx Index
items.summary: DRW and Marex completed the first OTC swap referencing a fully tokenized index on Derivnex via the Canton Network, with Kaiko data.

items.title: AI Powered PlayStation Crack Could Let You Play GTA 6 on PC at Launch
items.summary: AnyPS5 is working to get any PS5 game running natively on PC—and gamers are hoping it'll work for the next instalment of Grand Theft Auto.

items.title: Ledger confirms hardware implant in CryptoBilis reseller units as MediaMarkt suspends sales in Europe
items.summary: Ledger confirmed a hardware implant in CryptoBilis-sold devices steals recovery phrases, as MediaMarkt suspends sales.

items.title: Anthropic warns ‘AI worms’ may autonomously spread across devices like a virus
items.summary: Anthropic warned that rogue “AI worms” are months away from the ability to self-replicate and autonomously infect user devices such as home appliances and other internet-connected devices.
